title.en: A Day in the Life of a Young Muslim
A day in the life of a young Muslim

intro.en: Read how a young Muslim spends his day: waking up with a dua, entering and leaving places with the right foot, praying Fajr in the mosque, reading Quran, and doing his work well. Read slowly and notice the sunnah manners.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke ek naujawan Musalman apna din kaise guzarta hai: dua ke saath uthna, sahi paon se andar aur bahar jana, Fajr masjid mein parhna, Quran parhna aur apna kaam acchi tarah karna. Aahista parhein aur sunnat adaab par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: اقْرَأْ كَيْفَ يَقْضي ناشِئٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَوْمَهُ: يَسْتَيْقِظُ بِدُعاء، وَيَدْخُلُ الأَماكِنَ وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْها بِالرِّجْلِ الصَّحيحَة، وَيُصَلّي الفَجْرَ في المَسْجِد، وَيَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ، وَيُتْقِنُ عَمَلَهُ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَلاحِظْ آدابَ السُّنَّة.

dialogue.ar: هِشامٌ ناشِئٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مَعَ أَذانِ الفَجْرِ، وَيَقولُ الدُّعاءَ الَّذي عَلَّمَهُ إِيّاهُ أَبوهُ.
dialogue.tr: hishāmun nāshiʾun muslimun yastayqiẓu maʿa adhāni l-fajr wa-yaqūlu d-duʿāʾa lladhī ʿallamahu iyyāhu abūh
dialogue.en: Hisham is a young Muslim who wakes up with the Fajr call and says the dua his father taught him.
dialogue.ur: Hisham ek naujawan Musalman hai jo Fajr ki azaan ke saath jaagta hai aur woh dua parhta hai jo uske walid ne sikhai.

dialogue.ar: وَعِنْدَ دُخولِ الحَمّامِ لِقَضاءِ الحاجَةِ يُقَدِّمُ الرِّجْلَ اليُسْرى، وَيُقَدِّمُ اليُمْنى عِنْدَ الخُروجِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ʿinda dukhūli l-ḥammāmi liqaḍāʾi l-ḥājati yuqaddimu r-rijla l-yusrā wa-yuqaddimu l-yumnā ʿinda l-khurūj
dialogue.en: At the bathroom door, to relieve himself, he steps in with the left foot first, and steps out with the right.
dialogue.ur: Qaza-e-haajat ke liye ghusalkhane mein jaate waqt woh baayan paaon pehle rakhta hai aur nikalte waqt daayan paaon pehle.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ يُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ جَسَدِهِ وَمَلابِسِهِ، وَيَبْتَعِدُ عَنِ النَّجاساتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-huwa yuḥāfiẓu ʿalā naẓāfati jasadihi wa-malābisih wa-yabtaʿidu ʿani n-najāsāt
dialogue.en: He keeps his body and clothes clean and stays away from impurities.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne jism aur kapdon ki safai ka khayal rakhta hai aur najasaton se door rehta hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ، وَيَدْعو بَعْدَ الوُضوءِ بِالدُّعاءِ الَّذي حَفِظَهُ.
dialogue.tr: thumma yatawaḍḍaʾ wa-yadʿū baʿda l-wuḍūʾi bid-duʿāʾi lladhī ḥafiẓah
dialogue.en: Then he performs wudu and, after it, makes the dua he has memorised.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh wudu karta hai aur wudu ke baad woh dua parhta hai jo usne yaad ki hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَبْلَ الأَذانِ بِوَقْتٍ كافٍ صَلّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ تَهَجُّداً.
dialogue.tr: wa-ʾidhā stayqaẓa qabla l-ʾadhāni biwaqtin kāfin ṣallā rakʿatayni tahajjudā
dialogue.en: If he wakes well before the call to prayer, he prays two rakʿahs as night prayer.
dialogue.ur: Agar woh azaan se kaafi pehle jaag jaye to do rakaat tahajjud parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ يَطْلُعُ الفَجْرُ يُصَلّي سُنَّةَ الفَجْرِ، ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ مَعَ أَبيهِ إِلى المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ḥīna yaṭluʿu l-fajru yuṣallī sunnata l-fajr thumma yakhruju maʿa abīhi ilā l-masjid
dialogue.en: When dawn breaks he prays the Fajr sunnah, then goes out with his father to the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Jab fajr roshan hoti hai to woh Fajr ki sunnat parhta hai, phir apne walid ke saath masjid jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُؤَدّي الفَرْضَ جَماعَةً في مَسْجِدِ الحَيِّ، وَلا يَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْها.
dialogue.tr: wa-yuʾaddī l-farḍa jamāʿatan fī masjidi l-ḥayy wa-lā yataʾakhkaru ʿanhā
dialogue.en: He prays the obligatory prayer in congregation in the neighbourhood mosque and does not come late to it.
dialogue.ur: Woh farz namaz mohalle ki masjid mein jamaat ke saath ada karta hai aur usse der nahi karta.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ الصَّلاةِ يَجْلِسُ قَليلاً وَيَقْرَأُ ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ وَالأَذْكارِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-baʿda ṣ-ṣalāti yajlisu qalīlan wa-yaqraʾu mā tayassara mina l-qurʾāni wal-ʾadhkār
dialogue.en: After the prayer he sits for a little and reads what is easy of the Quran and the adhkar.
dialogue.ur: Namaz ke baad woh thori der baithta hai aur Quran aur azkar mein se jo aasaan ho parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ يَعودُ إِلى البَيْتِ فَيَتَناوَلُ فُطورَهُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِهِ، وَيَذْهَبُ إِلى مَدْرَسَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma yaʿūdu ilā l-bayti fa-yatanāwalu fuṭūrahu maʿa usratih wa-yadhhabu ilā madrasatih
dialogue.en: Then he returns home, has breakfast with his family, and goes to his school.
dialogue.ur: Phir ghar lautta hai, apne ghar walon ke saath nashta karta hai aur apne school jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُناكَ يَجْلِسُ بِجانِبِ زَميلِهِ وَيَنْتَبِهُ لِدُروسِهِ وَيَحْتَرِمُ مُعَلِّمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-hunāka yajlisu bijānibi zamīlihi wa-yantabihu lidurūsihi wa-yaḥtarimu muʿallimah
dialogue.en: There he sits next to his classmate, pays attention to his lessons and respects his teacher.
dialogue.ur: Wahan woh apne hum-jamaat ke saath baithta hai, apne sabaq par tawajjuh deta hai aur ustaad ka adab karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي المَساءِ يُؤَدّي واجِباتِهِ كامِلَةً، وَيَنامُ بَعْدَ أَذْكارِ النَّوْمِ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ.
dialogue.tr: wa-fī l-masāʾi yuʾaddī wājibātihi kāmila wa-yanāmu baʿda adhkāri n-nawmi wa-qalbuhu muṭmaʾinn
dialogue.en: In the evening he completes his duties and sleeps after the bedtime adhkar with a content heart.
dialogue.ur: Shaam ko woh apne farayez poore karta hai aur sone ke azkar ke baad mutmain dil ke saath sota hai.

q.en: The young Muslim enters the toilet with which foot?
q.ur: Naujawan baitul khala mein kaun sa paon pehle rakhta hai?
q.ar: بِأَيِّ رِجْلٍ يَدْخُلُ الناشِئُ المُسْلِمُ الخَلاءَ؟

q.ur: «يَسْتَيْقِظُ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: He wakes up / Woh jaagta hai
He travels / Woh safar karta hai

q.ur: "Jamaat" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الصَّلاةَ مَعَ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِد؟

q.ur: Woh Fajr kahan parhta hai?

q.en: What does he read after Fajr to begin his day?
q.ur: Fajr ke baad din shuru karne ke liye kya parhta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقْرَأُ بَعْدَ الفَجْرِ لِيَبْدَأَ يَوْمَه؟

intro.en: Practise what you read: true or false sentences, finding the sentence that gives a meaning, opposites, plurals and synonyms. These word pairs help you build a stronger vocabulary.
intro.ur: Jo parha usay yaad karne ki mashq: sahi ya ghalat jumle, kisi matlab ka jumla dhoondna, ulte alfaaz, jama aur hum-maani alfaaz. Yeh jode aapka zakheera-e-alfaaz mazboot karte hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما قَرَأْتَ: جُمَلٌ صَحيحَةٌ أَوْ خاطِئَة، وَإيجادُ الجُمْلَةِ الَّتي تُعْطي مَعْنىً، وَالأَضْدادُ وَالجُموعُ وَالمُرادِفات. هَذِهِ الأَزْواجُ مِنَ الكَلِماتِ تُقَوّي ثَرْوَتَكَ اللُّغَوِيَّة.

dialogue.ar: الصّادِقُ يُحِبُّهُ النّاسُ، وَالكاذِبُ يَفْقِدُ ثِقَتَهُمْ. هَلِ الجُمْلَةُ صَوابٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ؟
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣādiqu yuḥibbuhu n-nās wal-kādhibu yafqidu thiqatahum hali l-jumlatu ṣawābun am khaṭaʾ
dialogue.en: The truthful person is loved by people, and the liar loses their trust. Is the sentence correct or wrong?
dialogue.ur: Sachay se log mohabbat karte hain aur jhoota unka bharosa kho deta hai. Kya yeh jumla durust hai ya ghalat?

dialogue.ar: اِبْحَثْ في النَّصِّ عَنْ جُمْلَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّ المُسْلِمَ يُحافِظُ عَلى جَسَدِهِ وَمَلابِسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ibḥath fī n-naṣṣi ʿan jumlatin tadullu ʿalā anna l-muslima yuḥāfiẓu ʿalā jasadihi wa-malābisih
dialogue.en: Find in the text a sentence showing that the Muslim takes care of his body and clothes.
dialogue.ur: Matn mein woh jumla talash karein jo batata hai ke Musalman apne jism aur kapdon ki hifazat karta hai.

dialogue.ar: ما ضِدُّ كَلِمَةِ «القَوِيّ»؟ وَما ضِدُّ كَلِمَةِ «جَديد»؟
dialogue.tr: mā ḍiddu kalimati l-qawiyy wa-mā ḍiddu kalimati jadīd
dialogue.en: What is the opposite of the word 'strong'? And the opposite of 'new'?
dialogue.ur: Lafz 'qawi' ka ulta kya hai? Aur 'jadeed' ka ulta kya hai?

dialogue.ar: ما جَمْعُ كَلِمَةِ «ثَوْب»؟ وَما جَمْعُ كَلِمَةِ «حاجَة»؟
dialogue.tr: mā jamʿu kalimati thawb wa-mā jamʿu kalimati ḥāja
dialogue.en: What is the plural of the word 'thawb' (garment)? And the plural of 'haja' (need)?
dialogue.ur: Lafz 'thawb' (kapda) ki jama kya hai? Aur 'haja' (zaroorat) ki jama kya hai?

dialogue.ar: مَنْ هُمْ أَصْدِقاؤُكَ؟ وَماذا تَفْعَلُ مَعَهُمْ بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ؟
dialogue.tr: man hum aṣdiqāʾuk wa-mādhā tafʿalu maʿahum baʿda d-dars
dialogue.en: Who are your friends? And what do you do with them after the lesson?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke dost kaun hain? Aur sabaq ke baad aap un ke saath kya karte hain?

q.ur: «جَديد» ka ulta kya hai?
«ثَوْب» ki jama kya hai?

q.en: Which word is a synonym of «رَجَعَ» (he returned)?
q.ur: «رَجَعَ» ka hum-maani lafz kaun sa hai?
«الضَّعيف» ka ulta kya hai?
«أَصْدِقاء» ka matlab:

intro.en: In a sentence that starts with a noun (the mubtada), the part that completes the meaning is the khabar. The khabar can be a single word, a full sentence, or a prepositional or adverb phrase. Example: الطّالِبَةُ ناجِحَةٌ – 'The student is successful' (ناجِحَة is a single-word khabar).
intro.ur: Jo jumla ism se shuru ho uski pehli cheez mubtada hoti hai, aur jo baat usay mukammal kare woh khabar hai. Khabar ek lafz ho sakti hai, poora jumla ho sakti hai, ya shibh-e-jumla (jaar majroor ya zarf). Misal: الطّالِبَةُ ناجِحَةٌ – 'Talibah kamyab hai' (ناجِحَة ek lafz ki khabar hai).
intro.ar: في الجُمْلَةِ الَّتي تَبْدَأُ بِاسْمٍ (المُبْتَدَأ) يُسَمّى الجُزْءُ الَّذي يُتِمُّ المَعْنى الخَبَر. وَالخَبَرُ قَدْ يَكونُ كَلِمَةً واحِدَة، أَوْ جُمْلَة، أَوْ شِبْهَ جُمْلَة (جارّاً وَمَجْروراً أَوْ ظَرْفاً). مِثال: الطّالِبَةُ ناجِحَةٌ، فَـ «ناجِحَةٌ» خَبَرٌ مُفْرَد.

dialogue.ar: الطّالِبَةُ ناجِحَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibatu nājiḥa
dialogue.en: The (female) student is successful. (single word)
dialogue.ur: Talibah kamyab hai. (ek lafz)

dialogue.ar: العَدْلُ أَساسُهُ مَتينٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿadlu asāsuhu matīn
dialogue.en: Justice, its foundation is firm. (a sentence as khabar)
dialogue.ur: Insaaf, uski buniyad mazboot hai. (jumla khabar ke tor par)

dialogue.ar: الرُّواةُ يَنْقُلونَ الأَخْبارَ بِأَمانَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: ar-ruwātu yanqulūna l-ʾakhbāra biʾamāna
dialogue.en: The narrators pass on reports with trustworthiness. (verbal sentence)
dialogue.ur: Rawi khabrein amanat ke saath naqal karte hain. (jumla fi'liya)

dialogue.ar: الكِتابُ في الحَقيبَةِ.
dialogue.tr: al-kitābu fī l-ḥaqība
dialogue.en: The book is in the bag. (prepositional phrase)
dialogue.ur: Kitab bastay mein hai. (jaar majroor)

dialogue.ar: المَدْرَسَةُ أَمامَ المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: al-madrasatu amāma l-masjid
dialogue.en: The school is in front of the mosque. (adverb phrase)
dialogue.ur: School masjid ke saamne hai. (zarf)

dialogue.ar: الجَهْلُ عَدُوُّ الإِنْسانِ.
dialogue.tr: al-jahlu ʿaduwwu l-ʾinsān
dialogue.en: Ignorance is the enemy of man. (single word)
dialogue.ur: Jahalat insaan ki dushman hai. (ek lafz)

q.ur: «الطّالِبَةُ ناجِحَةٌ» mein khabar kya hai?

q.en: «الرُّواةُ يَنْقُلونَ الأَخْبارَ بِأَمانَةٍ»: the khabar is a:
q.ur: «الرُّواةُ يَنْقُلونَ الأَخْبارَ بِأَمانَةٍ» mein khabar kya hai?

q.en: «الكِتابُ في الحَقيبَةِ»: the khabar is a:
q.ur: «الكِتابُ في الحَقيبَةِ» mein khabar kya hai?
«المَدْرَسَةُ أَمامَ المَسْجِدِ» mein «أَمامَ» kya hai?
Nahw mein «الخَبَر» kya hai?

options: The part that completes the meaning of the subject / Woh hissa jo mubtada ko mukammal kare
The first word of the sentence / Jumle ka pehla lafz
A verb in the past / Fe'l-e-maazi
A question word / Sawal ka lafz

intro.en: Read the five questions about sons and parents, then think and answer them aloud. They ask why teenagers need patience, how parents can be fair, what changes appear in adolescence, how to guide children in using the phone, and what the effect is of those who spread corruption instead of reform.
intro.ur: Beton aur walidain ke baare mein paanch sawalat parhein, phir sochkar zubani jawab dein. In mein poocha gaya hai ke nojawan ko sabr ki zaroorat kyun hai, walidain insaaf kaise karein, balooghat mein kaun si tabdeeliyan aati hain, bachon ko mobile ke istemal mein rehnumai kaise di jaye, aur fasaad phelane walon ka kya asar hota hai.
intro.ar: اقْرَأِ الأَسْئِلَةَ الخَمْسَةَ عَنِ الأَبْناءِ وَالوالِدَيْن، ثُمَّ فَكِّرْ وَأَجِبْ شَفَهِيّاً. تَسْأَلُ عَنْ حاجَةِ المُراهِقِ إِلى الصَّبْر، وَعَنِ العَدْلِ بَيْنَ الأَبْناء، وَعَنْ تَغَيُّراتِ المُراهَقَة، وَعَنْ تَوْجيهِ الأَبْناءِ في اسْتِعْمالِ الهاتِفِ الجَوّال، وَعَنْ أَثَرِ مَنْ يُفْسِدونَ وَلا يُصْلِحونَ.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يَحْتاجُ المُراهِقُ إِلى صَبْرِ والِدَيْهِ؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā yaḥtāju l-murāhiqu ilā ṣabri wālidayh
dialogue.en: Why does a teenager need his parents' patience?
dialogue.ur: Nojawan ko apne walidain ke sabr ki zaroorat kyun hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يَكونُ الوالِدانِ عادِلَيْنِ بَيْنَ أَبْنائِهِما؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa yakūnu l-wālidāni ʿādilayni bayna abnāʾihimā
dialogue.en: How can parents be fair between their children?
dialogue.ur: Walidain apni aulad ke darmiyan insaaf kaise karein?

dialogue.ar: ما التَّغَيُّراتُ الجَسَدِيَّةُ وَالنَّفْسِيَّةُ وَالعَقْلِيَّةُ الَّتي تَظْهَرُ في المُراهَقَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā t-taghayyurātu l-jasadiyyatu wan-nafsiyyatu wal-ʿaqliyyatu llatī taẓharu fī l-murāhaqa
dialogue.en: What physical, psychological and mental changes appear in adolescence?
dialogue.ur: Balooghat mein kaun si jismani, nafsiyati aur zehni tabdeeliyan zahir hoti hain?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ نُوَجِّهُ أَبْناءَنا في اسْتِعْمالِ الهاتِفِ الجَوّالِ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa nuwajjihu abnāʾanā fī stiʿmāli l-hātifi l-jawwāl
dialogue.en: How do we guide our children in using the mobile phone?
dialogue.ur: Hum apne bachon ki mobile phone ke istemal mein rehnumai kaise karein?

dialogue.ar: ما أَثَرُ الَّذينَ يُفْسِدونَ وَلا يُصْلِحونَ في المُجْتَمَعِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā atharu lladhīna yufsidūna wa-lā yuṣliḥūna fī l-mujtamaʿ
dialogue.en: What is the effect on society of those who spread corruption and do not reform?
dialogue.ur: Jo log fasaad phelate hain aur islah nahi karte unka muashre par kya asar hota hai?

q.ur: «المُراهِق» ka matlab kya hai?
«الوالِدان» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which is NOT a type of change a teenager goes through?
q.ur: Nojawan mein kaun si tabdili NAHI aati?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ لَيْسَتْ مِنَ التَّغَيُّراتِ الَّتي تُصيبُ المُراهِق؟

q.ur: «تَرْبِيَة الأَوْلاد» kiski zimmedari hai?

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner about your day: when you wake up, your first and last actions, and when you sleep. Then write about "A Day in My Life" using the given points, such as breakfast, school, Quran recitation and sleep.
intro.ur: Apne saathi se apne din ke baare mein baat karne ki mashq: aap kab jaagte hain, pehla aur aakhri kaam kya hota hai aur kab sote hain. Phir diye gaye nukaat ki madad se 'Mere din ka ek din' likhein, jaise nashta, school, Quran ki tilawat aur neend.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى الحَديثِ عَنْ يَوْمِك: مَتى تَسْتَيْقِظ، وَأَوَّلُ عَمَلٍ وَآخِرُ عَمَلٍ تَقومُ بِه، وَمَتى تَنام. ثُمَّ اكْتُبْ عَنْ «يَوْمٍ في حَياتي» مُسْتَعيناً بِالنِّقاطِ المُعْطاة، كَالفُطورِ وَالمَدْرَسَةِ وَتِلاوَةِ القُرْآنِ وَالنَّوْم.

dialogue.ar: في أَيِّ ساعَةٍ تَصْحو مِنَ النَّوْمِ صَباحاً؟
dialogue.tr: fī ayyi sāʿatin taṣḥū mina n-nawmi ṣabāḥā
dialogue.en: At what hour do you wake up in the morning?
dialogue.ur: Aap subah kis waqt neend se jaagte hain?

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَقولُ أَوَّلاً عِنْدَما تَفْتَحُ عَيْنَيْكَ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taqūlu awwalan ʿindamā taftaḥu ʿaynayk
dialogue.en: What do you say first when you open your eyes?
dialogue.ur: Aankh kholte hi aap sab se pehle kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما آخِرُ شَيْءٍ تَفْعَلُهُ لَيْلاً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنامَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ʾākhiru shayʾin tafʿaluhu laylan qabla an tanām
dialogue.en: What is the last thing you do at night before you sleep?
dialogue.ur: Raat ko sone se pehle aap aakhri kaam kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّهُما أَجْمَلُ في رَأْيِكَ: النَّوْمُ مُبَكِّراً أَمِ السَّهَرُ مُتَأَخِّراً؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: ayyuhumā ajmalu fī raʾyik an-nawmu mubakkiran ami s-saharu mutaʾakhkirā limādhā
dialogue.en: Which is better in your opinion: sleeping early or staying up late? Why?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki raaye mein kya behtar hai: jaldi sona ya der tak jaagna? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: اُكْتُبْ عَنْ يَوْمِكَ: الفُطورُ، المَدْرَسَةُ، تِلاوَةُ القُرْآنِ، النَّوْمُ لَيْلاً.
dialogue.tr: uktub ʿan yawmik al-fuṭūr al-madrasa tilāwatu l-qurʾān an-nawmu laylā
dialogue.en: Write about your day: breakfast, school, reciting the Quran, sleeping at night.
dialogue.ur: Apne din ke baare mein likhein: nashta, school, Quran ki tilawat, raat ko sona.

q.ur: «مُبَكِّراً» ka matlab kya hai?
"Neend" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
Kaun sa waqt "ghuroob-e-aftaab" hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ وَقْتِ صَلاةٍ يَكونُ عِنْدَ غُروبِ الشَّمْس؟

q.ur: «النَّوْمُ مُبَكِّراً» ka matlab hai sona:

title.en: Spelling: the soft alif at the end of nouns
title.ur: Imla: Ism ke aakhir ki alif layyina

intro.en: A noun can end with a long ā sound written as alif (ا) or as yā-shaped alif (ى). Rule for three-letter words: if the alif comes from waw, write ا (عَصا); if from yā, write ى (فَتى). For words longer than three letters: if a yā comes before the alif, write ا (قَضايا); otherwise write ى (مُصْطَفى).
intro.ur: Ism ke aakhir mein 'aa' ki awaaz alif (ا) ya alif maqsura (ى) se likhi jati hai. Teen harfi lafz mein agar alif 'waw' se bana ho to ا likhte hain (عَصا), aur 'ya' se bana ho to ى (فَتى). Teen se zyada harf wale lafz mein agar alif se pehle 'ya' ho to ا (قَضايا), warna ى (مُصْطَفى).
intro.ar: قَدْ يَنْتَهي الاسْمُ بِأَلِفٍ لَيِّنَةٍ تُكْتَبُ أَلِفاً (ا) أَوْ ياءً بِلا نُقَطٍ (ى). في الاسْمِ الثُّلاثِيِّ: إِنْ كانَ أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ واواً كُتِبَتْ ا (عَصا)، وَإِنْ كانَ ياءً كُتِبَتْ ى (فَتى). وَفي ما زادَ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ: إِنْ سَبَقَتْها ياءٌ كُتِبَتْ ا (قَضايا)، وَإِلّا كُتِبَتْ ى (مُصْطَفى).

dialogue.ar: الكَلِماتُ: رَجا، صَفا، سَنا، قَفا — أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ فيها واوٌ، فَنَكْتُبُها بِالأَلِفِ (ا).
dialogue.tr: al-kalimāt rajā ṣafā sanā qafā aṣlu l-ʾalifi fīhā wāw fa-naktubuhā bil-ʾalifi
dialogue.en: Words: 'edge, rock, radiance, nape' – the alif comes from waw, so we write it with alif.
dialogue.ur: Alfaaz: 'kinara, chattan, roshni, gardan ka pichhla hissa' – inmein alif ki asal waw hai, isliye alif (ا) se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: الكَلِماتُ: هُدى، رِضى، نَدى، حِمى — أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ فيها ياءٌ، فَنَكْتُبُها بِالياءِ غَيْرِ المَنْقوطَةِ (ى).
dialogue.tr: al-kalimāt hudā riḍā nadā ḥimā aṣlu l-ʾalifi fīhā yāʾ fa-naktubuhā bil-yāʾi ghayri l-manqūṭati ā
dialogue.en: Words: 'guidance, contentment, dew, protected land' – the alif comes from yā, so we write it with ى.
dialogue.ur: Alfaaz: 'hidayat, razamandi, shabnam, mehfooz ilaqa' – inmein alif ki asal ya hai, isliye bina nuqte wali ى se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: الكَلِماتُ: هَدايا، وَصايا، زَوايا، مَطايا — جاءَتْ ياءٌ قَبْلَ الأَلِفِ، فَنَكْتُبُها بِالأَلِفِ (ا).
dialogue.tr: al-kalimāt hadāyā wa-ṣāyā zawāyā maṭāyā jāʾat yāʾun qabla l-ʾalif fa-naktubuhā bil-ʾalifi
dialogue.en: Words: 'gifts, counsels, corners, mounts' – a yā comes before the alif, so we write it with alif.
dialogue.ur: Alfaaz: 'tohfe, naseehatein, kone, sawariyan' – alif se pehle ya aati hai, isliye alif (ا) se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: الكَلِماتُ: مُسْتَشْفى، مَعْنى، كُبْرى، ذِكْرى — فَوْقَ ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ وَلا ياءَ قَبْلَ الأَلِفِ، فَنَكْتُبُها بِالياءِ (ى).
dialogue.tr: al-kalimāt mustashfā maʿnā kubrā dhikrā fa-wqa thalāthati aḥrufin wa-lā yāʾa qabla l-ʾalif fa-naktubuhā bil-yāʾi ā
dialogue.en: Words: 'hospital, meaning, greatest, remembrance' – more than three letters and no yā before the alif, so we write it with ى.
dialogue.ur: Alfaaz: 'hospital, matlab, sab se badi, yaad' – teen se ziyada huroof hain aur alif se pehle ya nahi, isliye ى se likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: لا عَدْوى وَلا طِيَرَة.
dialogue.tr: lā ʿadwā wa lā ṭiyara
dialogue.en: There is no contagion (by itself) and no bad omen.
dialogue.ur: Na chhoot (khud se) hai na badshagooni.

dialogue.ar: حَمَلَ الفَتى عَصاً وَمَشى إِلى المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥamala l-fatā ʿaṣan wa-mashā ilā l-masjid
dialogue.en: The youth carried a stick and walked to the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Naujawan ne lathi uthai aur masjid ki taraf chala.

vocab.ur: chuna hua, Nabi ﷺ ka laqab

q.en: How is «عَصا» written at the end, and why?
q.ur: «عَصا» aakhir mein kaise likhte hain aur kyun?

options: With alif (ا), its origin is waw
With ى, its origin is yā
With ى, it has four letters
With alif, it is a verb

q.ur: «فَتى» kaise likha jata hai aur kyun?

options: With ى, its origin is yā
With alif, its origin is waw
With ى, it comes after yā

q.ur: «قَضايا» ka aakhir kaise likhte hain aur kyun?

options: With alif, a yā comes before the alif
With ى, it is a name
With ى, it is a verb
With alif, it has three letters

q.en: Which word is written with ى?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ى se likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الكَلِماتِ الآتِيَةِ تُكْتَبُ بِـ ى؟

title.ur: Qawaid: Khabar ko mubtada se pehle lana

intro.en: Usually the mubtada comes first and the khabar after it. But sometimes the khabar must come first, for example when it is a question word (أَيْنَ), when the mubtada is limited by «إِنَّما» or «ما … إلا», or when a pronoun in the mubtada refers back to the khabar (لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ). Example: في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ – 'In the room there is a teacher'.
intro.ur: Aam tor par mubtada pehle aur khabar baad mein aati hai. Lekin kabhi khabar ko pehle lana zaroori hota hai, jaise jab khabar sawali lafz ho (أَيْنَ), jab mubtada 'إِنَّما' ya 'ما … إلا' se mahdood ho, ya jab mubtada ki zameer khabar ki taraf laute (لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ). Misal: في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ – 'Kamre mein ek ustaad hai'.
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ المُبْتَدَأُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِيَ الخَبَر. لَكِنَّ الخَبَرَ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَحْياناً: إِذا كانَ اسْمَ اسْتِفْهامٍ (أَيْنَ)، أَوْ كانَ المُبْتَدَأُ مَحْصوراً بِـ «إِنَّما» أَوْ «ما … إِلّا»، أَوْ عادَ ضَميرٌ في المُبْتَدَأِ عَلى الخَبَر (لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ). مِثال: في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ.

dialogue.ar: في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ghurfati mudarris
dialogue.en: In the room there is a teacher.
dialogue.ur: Kamre mein ek ustaad hai.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَ جَدّي بُسْتانٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿinda jaddī bustān
dialogue.en: At my grandfather's there is an orchard.
dialogue.ur: Mere dada ke paas ek bagh hai.

dialogue.ar: بَيْنَ صَفَحاتِ الكِتابِ وَرَقَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: bayna ṣafaḥāti l-kitābi wa-raqa
dialogue.en: Between the pages of the book there is a slip of paper.
dialogue.ur: Kitab ke safhon ke darmiyan ek parcha hai.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَ المَدْرَسَةُ؟ مَتى الاخْتِبارُ؟ كَيْفَ الطَّقْسُ اليَوْمَ؟
dialogue.tr: ayna l-madrasa matā l-ikhtibār kayfa ṭ-ṭaqsu l-yawm
dialogue.en: Where is the school? When is the exam? How is the weather today?
dialogue.ur: School kahan hai? Imtihan kab hai? Aaj mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: ما الفائِزُ إِلّا طارِقٌ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-fāʾizu illā ṭāriq
dialogue.en: The winner is none other than Tariq.
dialogue.ur: Jeetne wala Tariq hi hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما القائِدُ سَعيدٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-qāʾidu saʿīd
dialogue.en: The leader is only Saeed.
dialogue.ur: Qaid sirf Saeed hai.

dialogue.ar: لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ، وَلِلطّالِبَةِ اجْتِهادُها.
dialogue.tr: lil-muʿallimi fa-ḍluh wa-lilṭṭālibati jtihāduhā
dialogue.en: The teacher has his merit, and the (female) student her diligence.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad ki apni fazilat hai aur talibah ki apni mehnat.

q.en: In «في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ», which part comes first?
q.ur: «في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ» mein pehle kaun sa hissa aata hai?
q.ar: في «في الغُرْفَةِ مُدَرِّسٌ» أَيُّ جُزْءٍ يَأْتي أَوَّلاً؟

q.en: In «أَيْنَ المَدْرَسَةُ؟» the khabar «أَيْنَ» comes first because it is:
q.ur: «أَيْنَ المَدْرَسَةُ؟» mein khabar «أَيْنَ» pehle kyun aati hai?

q.en: In «ما الفائِزُ إِلّا طارِقٌ», the khabar must come:
q.ur: «ما الفائِزُ إِلّا طارِقٌ» mein khabar kahan aani chahiye?
q.ar: في «ما الفائِزُ إِلّا طارِقٌ» يَأْتي الخَبَرُ:

options: After the mubtada (limited by ما … إلا)
options_ar: بَعْدَ المُبْتَدَأ، لِأَنَّهُ مَحْصورٌ بِـ ما … إِلّا

q.en: «لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ»: why must the khabar come first?
q.ur: «لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ» mein khabar pehle kyun aani chahiye?
q.ar: في «لِلْمُعَلِّمِ فَضْلُهُ» لِماذا يَجِبُ تَقْديمُ الخَبَر؟

options: The pronoun in the mubtada refers to a word in the khabar
options_ar: لِأَنَّ الضَّميرَ في المُبْتَدَأِ يَعودُ عَلى كَلِمَةٍ في الخَبَر

q.ur: "Ke darmiyan" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يَقَعُ في الوَسَطِ مِنْ مَكانَيْن؟
